answer: Because the timing is recorded against the cipher challenge, the whisper audit can replay the wharf history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 346 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. A farm of 965 identities would post 2870 proofs and burn roughly 72 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
